## D3 Treemap Example

```{ojs}
// 1. Define your data
data = ({
  name: "root",
  children: [
    { name: "Group A", children: [{name: "A1", value: 50}, {name: "A2", value: 30}] },
    { name: "Group B", children: [{name: "B1", value: 40}, {name: "B2", value: 10}] },
    { name: "Group C", value: 20 }
  ]
})

// 2. Set dimensions
width = 600
height = 400

// 3. Process the hierarchy
root = {
  const h = d3.hierarchy(data)
      .sum(d => d.value)
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  return d3.treemap()
      .size([width, height])
      .padding(2)
      (h);
}

// 4. Render the SVG
chart = {
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .style("font", "12px sans-serif");

  const leaf = svg.selectAll("g")
    .data(root.leaves())
    .join("g")
    .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x0},${d.y0})`);

  leaf.append("rect")
    .attr("fill", d => { while (d.depth > 1) d = d.parent; return d3.schemeTableau10[data.children.indexOf(d.data) % 10]; })
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)
    .attr("width", d => d.x1 - d.x0)
    .attr("height", d => d.y1 - d.y0);

  leaf.append("text")
    .attr("x", 5)
    .attr("y", 15)
    .text(d => d.data.name);

  return svg.node();
}
```

```{ojs}
// 1. Data and Dimensions
data = ({
  name: "root",
  children: [
    { name: "Analytics", children: [{name: "Logs", value: 50}, {name: "Metrics", value: 30}] },
    { name: "Storage", children: [{name: "SQL", value: 40}, {name: "NoSQL", value: 25}] },
    { name: "Compute", value: 45 }
  ]
})

width = 600
height = 400

// 2. Hierarchy Logic
root = {
  const h = d3.hierarchy(data)
      .sum(d => d.value)
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  return d3.treemap()
      .size([width, height])
      .padding(2)
      (h);
}

// 3. Render SVG
chart = {
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .style("font", "12px sans-serif");

  const leaf = svg.selectAll("g")
    .data(root.leaves())
    .join("g")
    .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x0},${d.y0})`);

  // Hover effect and Tooltip
  leaf.append("rect")
    .attr("fill", d => { 
        let p = d; while (p.depth > 1) p = p.parent; 
        return d3.schemeTableau10[data.children.indexOf(p.data) % 10]; 
    })
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)
    .attr("width", d => d.x1 - d.x0)
    .attr("height", d => d.y1 - d.y0)
    .on("mouseover", function() { d3.select(this).attr("fill-opacity", 1); })
    .on("mouseout", function() { d3.select(this).attr("fill-opacity", 0.7); })
    .append("title") // Standard browser tooltip
    .text(d => `${d.data.name}: ${d.value}`);

  // Centered Text
  leaf.append("text")
    .attr("x", d => (d.x1 - d.x0) / 2) // Horizontal center
    .attr("y", d => (d.y1 - d.y0) / 2) // Vertical center
    .attr("dy", "0.35em")             // Offset for baseline alignment
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")    // Center text horizontally
    .attr("fill", "white")
    .style("pointer-events", "none")  // Ensure mouse events hit the rect
    .text(d => (d.x1 - d.x0 > 30) ? d.data.name : ""); // Only show if tile is wide enough

  return svg.node();
}


```
